rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a jug or pitcher.

example.english: This jug is the one Grandma has always used at home.
example.traditional: 呢個壺係阿嫲屋企用開嗰個。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wu4 hai6 aa3 maa4 uk1 kei2 jung6 hoi1 go2 go3

rows.note: Use this when the jug is specifically for holding or serving water.

example.english: Remember to bring the water jug hiking; there is no water to buy on the mountain.
example.traditional: 記得帶埋個水壺去行山，山上冇水買。
example.jyutping: gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 go3 seoi2 wu4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 saan1 soeng6 mou5 seoi2 maai5
